title: Claude for Life Sciences: Accelerating Discovery from Hypothesis to Breakthrough
description:
Join us for an exclusive look at how leading pharmaceutical companies and research institutions are transforming their R&D operations with Claude. See live demonstrations of hypothesis generation, protocol optimization, and bioinformatics analysis capabilities, as well as hear directly from life sciences industry leaders on how they're driving AI transformation at scale.

Whether you're evaluating AI for your research teams or scaling existing deployments, you'll leave with practical insights on achieving measurable outcomes in drug discovery, experimental design, literature analysis, and research efficiency.
